text:
Izzy: Tiny travel question for the offsite folks 1 whats the single oddball item you always shove in your bag that actually saves you? not chargers/toiletries.
Rohan: A 5cm binder clip (metal). holds paper badges, props for slides, or keeps my blazer sleeve rolled up. the tiny ones fit in a card slot. :clap:
Gabrielle: Little zip pouch with 3 safety pins + 2 needle-threaders. zipper pulls and badge straps die often.
Sam: Compression packing cubes. they actually make a carry-on look civilized and stop shirts from exploding. plus you can unzip one and use it as a dirty clothes bag.
Ethan: Shoe bag + a pair of thin gel insoles. saves sore feet and keeps shoe funk separated.
Izzy: Ooh Sam where do you tuck the cubes on the plane? under the seat?
Sam: Under seat for carry-on. I also wear the bulkiest layer on the plane to save space.
Rohan: Micro-hack: keep a photocopy of passport + one printed business card in a hidden pocket. phone die + no sim = you can show hotel/taxi the card.
Gabrielle: For formal nights: a tiny travel safety-stitched button kit. snaps on like a keycap, less than a quarter.
Ethan: For sleeping: tiny inflatable footrest (fits in coat pocket). stops the cramps on long flights. insane but works.
Izzy: Poll idea: react :one: binder clip, :two: packing cube, :three: shoe bag/insoles, :four: passport copy
Rohan: :one:
Gabrielle: :two:
Sam: :two: + saved
Ethan: :three:
Izzy: Love this1 Ill make a short printable with these micro-hacks and pin it to the offsite channel. extra credit if anyone actually carries an inflatable footrest
